Also note to self, steps to update:

```
CADVISOR_PIN="${SHA}" # or the tag
hack/pin-dependency.sh github.com/google/cadvisor ${CADVISOR_PIN}
```

and this little script to update all pins / vendor:

```
while true; do
  PINS_NEEDED=$(hack/lint-dependencies.sh  | grep "hack/pin-dependency.sh" | grep -v "Use hack/pin-dependency.sh" | awk '{$1=$1;print}')

  if [[ -z "${PINS_NEEDED}" ]]; then
    echo ">>> all done; no more pins"
    break
  fi

  while IFS= read -r line
  do
    echo ">>> Running pin ${line}"
    eval "${line}"
  done <<< "${PINS_NEEDED}"

  echo ">>> Vendoring"
  hack/update-vendor.sh

  REMOVES_NEEDED=$(hack/lint-dependencies.sh  | grep 'dropreplace' | awk '{$1=$1;print}')
  while IFS= read -r line
  do
    echo ">>> Running removal ${line}"
    eval "${line}"
  done <<< "${REMOVES_NEEDED}"

  if [[ -n "${REMOVES_NEEDED}" ]]; then
    echo ">>> Vendoring after drops"
    hack/update-vendor.sh
  fi
done
```

	want (*memory.InMemoryCache, sysfs.SysFs, struct { Interval *time.Duration; AllowDynamic *bool }, container.MetricSet, *http.Client, []string, string, *metrics.DenyList)
```

	have (context.Context, *container.Config, *container.HostConfig, *network.NetworkingConfig, string)
	want (context.Context, *container.Config, *container.HostConfig, *network.NetworkingConfig, *"k8s.io/kubernetes/vendor/github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/specs-go/v1".Platform, string)

caused by docker update, see https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/40725 

I think something like changes below will be sufficient:

```
diff --git a/pkg/kubelet/cadvisor/cadvisor_linux.go b/pkg/kubelet/cadvisor/cadvisor_linux.go
index 0c701cb98d3..befbebeddab 100644
--- a/pkg/kubelet/cadvisor/cadvisor_linux.go
+++ b/pkg/kubelet/cadvisor/cadvisor_linux.go
@@ -43,6 +43,7 @@ import (
        cadvisorapi "github.com/google/cadvisor/info/v1"
        cadvisorapiv2 "github.com/google/cadvisor/info/v2"
        "github.com/google/cadvisor/manager"
+       cadvisordenymetrics "github.com/google/cadvisor/metrics"
        "github.com/google/cadvisor/utils/sysfs"
        utilfeature "k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/util/feature"
        "k8s.io/klog/v2"
@@ -109,7 +110,11 @@ func New(imageFsInfoProvider ImageFsInfoProvider, rootPath string, cgroupRoots [
        }

        // Create the cAdvisor container manager.
-       m, err := manager.New(memory.New(statsCacheDuration, nil), sysFs, housekeepingConfig, includedMetrics, http.DefaultClient, cgroupRoots, "")
+       denyList, err := cadvisordenymetrics.NewDenyList([]string{})
+       if err != nil {
+               return nil, err
+       }
+       m, err := manager.New(memory.New(statsCacheDuration, nil), sysFs, housekeepingConfig, includedMetrics, http.DefaultClient, cgroupRoots, "", denyList)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }
diff --git a/pkg/kubelet/dockershim/libdocker/kube_docker_client.go b/pkg/kubelet/dockershim/libdocker/kube_docker_client.go

        if opts.HostConfig != nil && opts.HostConfig.ShmSize <= 0 {
                opts.HostConfig.ShmSize = defaultShmSize
        }

+       createResp, err := d.client.ContainerCreate(ctx, opts.Config, opts.HostConfig, opts.NetworkingConfig, nil, opts.Name)
        if ctxErr := contextError(ctx); ctxErr != nil {
                return nil, ctxErr
        }

review_comments: this makes calls that can return errors and log... is that expected on startup for the kubelet (it could happen when running things like `kubelet --help`)?

Thanks for looking through the dep changes.

With regards to this `init()` function, looks like this was refactored in https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/4953 and moved out of init(), but the change isn't in containerd v1.4.4 (only in unreleased containerd v1.5).

It looks like the main place error can happen here is if it can't open `/proc/cpuinfo` (https://github.com/containerd/containerd/blob/release%2F1.4/platforms/cpuinfo.go#L49-L53) which is hopefully unlikely :). Not clear what we can do here unfortunately considering we can't move to containerd v1.5 yet...

> It looks like the main place error can happen here is if it can't open /proc/cpuinfo (https://github.com/containerd/containerd/blob/release%2F1.4/platforms/cpuinfo.go#L49-L53) which is hopefully unlikely

if this code path happens on Windows, there is no /proc/ there.
This is ARM-only. Windows Server on ARM is still in Insider Preview, does Kubernetes support such configuration?

my comment was more of a remark that code should be written as preemptively OS-portable.

k8s doesn't produce ARM binaries for Windows. by the time (and if) we start doing that, the containerd version will likely be bumped to not have this init() code.
